thesis: Taste can be educated through demonstrable attention without treating prestige as authority or agreement as compulsory.

ideas.statement: Expertise enlarges perception but can exclude; informed disagreement may reveal competing aesthetic values rather than incompetence.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Contemplation needs material access; aesthetic education does not guarantee moral improvement and refinement can remove old pleasures.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Contemplation needs material access; aesthetic education does not guarantee moral improvement and refinement can remove old pleasures.
